title: Luminous Marsh: Exploration Platformer

foundation.history: The submerged civic bell was built to protect reeds and peat, but bioluminescent flooding interrupted its stewardship.

premise: Sela Rowan, a scout, must recover the missing navigation cores using momentum traversal while bioluminescent flooding threatens the submerged civic bell.
central_conflict: a collapsing frontier seeks control of reeds and peat; residents want accountable access.

plot_beats.name: Arrival
plot_beats.cause: bioluminescent flooding isolates the submerged civic bell
plot_beats.effect: Local routes and witnesses become inaccessible

plot_beats.name: The bargain
plot_beats.cause: a collapsing frontier offers privileged access to reeds and peat
plot_beats.effect: The player must decide whether to share information

plot_beats.name: The remedy
plot_beats.cause: The production plan determines who controls the restored system
plot_beats.effect: Faction trust changes the final public arrangement

endings.consequence: Stewardship passes to a representative public council
Resident cooperatives operate the recovered infrastructure
The essential route survives with unresolved governance debts
